facts.text: I completed my MBA degree a month ago.
I am planning a celebratory dinner for my achievement.
I am in New York City.
Around 10 people will be joining the dinner.
I am open to any type of cuisine.
I want to spend around $50-75 per person.
I would like a private room if possible.
I want to have dinner on a Saturday evening around 7 pm.
I want to know more about the menu and wine list at L'Artusi.
I want to know whether L'Artusi is flexible with customizing the menu for a special occasion.
I want help creating a playlist for the dinner.
I want background music to set the mood for the celebratory dinner.
I want to add Italian cafe music to the playlist to keep the Italian theme going.
I want recommendations for popular Italian cafe music artists or songs for the playlist.
I want to mix in Italian cafe music to keep the theme going.
I will consider adding classic Italian-American standards to give the playlist a retro vibe.
